Searchable online resource database at 211info.org; text your ZIP code to 898211

orgs.name: MULTNOMAH COUNTY COORDINATED ACCESS
services: THE FRONT DOOR for supportive housing in Multnomah County, run by the county Homeless Services Department (formerly the Joint Office of Homeless Services). Coordinated Access does not hand out rent checks itself - one assessment, the Multnomah Services and Screening Tool (MSST), matches prioritized households to transitional housing, rapid rehousing and permanent supportive housing
Adults: Coordinated Housing Access Team (CHAT) drop-in hours, the online MSST pre-screening (run by Transition Projects), or the CHAT warmline 844-765-9384
Culturally specific BIPOC assessments: BIPOC CHAT warmline 503-280-2600 (option 3) via the Urban League of Portland

Families with minor children: call 211. Veterans: 855-425-5544. Survivors of domestic/sexual violence: Call to Safety 503-235-5333. Youth under 25: Janus Youth Access Center, 635 SW Alder St, 503-432-3986
Prioritized households get a case manager who helps reduce barriers, obtain important documents and complete a warm hand-off to a housing program
orgs.serves: people experiencing homelessness in Multnomah County

orgs.name: MULTNOMAH COUNTY EVICTION PREVENTION & EMERGENCY RENT ASSISTANCE
services: START WITH 211: if you have an eviction notice, a written notice to vacate, or are at high risk of losing housing within 21 days, call 2-1-1 (or text your ZIP to 898211, or email help@211info.org) for a referral - referrals open weekly and close when full
Emergency Rent Assistance (state-supported): direct crisis support, landlord negotiation and application help through county-contracted community providers

Fiscal Year 2027 community providers named by the county: Bienestar de la Familia, El Programa Hispano Catolico, IRCO (Immigrant and Refugee Community Organization), Latino Network, Native American Youth and Family Center (NAYA), and SEI (Self Enhancement Inc.)

Short-Term Rent Assistance (STRA): a unified countywide program (up to 24 months of rent/mortgage help or emergency hotel vouchers) administered by Home Forward for Multnomah County, the City of Portland and the City of Gresham
City of Portland renters at or below 65% of Area Median Income qualify for the city-funded stream; there is no citizenship requirement
orgs.serves: Multnomah County households facing eviction or at risk of homelessness
